contracts.name: announcements
contracts.description: An organisation-scoped authored announcement with an explicit, versioned audience specification.

lifecycle.mutable: draft content and audience before publication; published audience is immutable; states advance only through declared transitions
lifecycle.purge: 730 days after expiry/retirement; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

contracts.name: communication_threads
contracts.description: An organisation-scoped conversation container for messages and participants.

lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after close/archive; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion; child history is retained consistently

contracts.name: direct_message_threads
contracts.description: Canonical pair mapping for a one-to-one direct-message thread.

lifecycle.mutable: none after creation; participants and workspace are immutable for this mapping
lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after parent thread closure; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

contracts.name: message_attachments
contracts.description: Metadata and opaque object-storage locator for an attachment belonging to a message.

lifecycle.mutable: deleted_at only; bytes are stored outside this relational table using an opaque storage reference
lifecycle.purge: Same 1095-day parent-message lifecycle; storage object deletion must honor governance hold and follow the parent message

contracts.name: messages
contracts.description: An ordered text message authored within a thread.

lifecycle.mutable: body may be corrected with edited_at; redaction sets state, redacted_at, redacted_by_user_id, and reason while preserving row identity
lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after parent thread closure; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

contracts.name: notification_deliveries
contracts.description: An append-oriented record of one channel delivery attempt for a notification.

lifecycle.mutable: one attempt advances through its declared lifecycle; each retry is a new row; terminal attempt evidence is preserved
lifecycle.purge: 180 days after terminal delivery state; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion; provider secrets are prohibited

contracts.name: notification_preferences
contracts.description: A user’s per-organisation opt-in/out preferences by notification category and channel; no provider credentials.

lifecycle.retentionAnchor: preference becomes inactive or owning organisation membership ends
lifecycle.purge: 90 days after inactive/terminal lifecycle; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

contracts.name: notifications
contracts.description: An in-product notification addressed to one user within one organisation.

lifecycle.mutable: state, read_at, dismissed_at, updated_at; transport is represented only by notification_deliveries
lifecycle.retentionAnchor: terminal read or dismissal time; unread items are not terminal
lifecycle.purge: 365 days after terminal/read/dismissed state; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

contracts.name: thread_members
contracts.description: Membership and per-user read position for a communication thread.

invariants.name: thread_membership_episode_cannot_be_reopened_or_rekeyed
invariants.terminalTransition: null-to-non-null-once; ended episodes cannot be reopened or have their end time rewritten

lifecycle.retentionAnchor: thread closure or membership end, whichever is later
lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after terminal anchor; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion
